guide.tensuranewworld.skills.title: SKILLS / HOW TO USE
guide.tensuranewworld.skills.category: 1. Choose a category or search. The full catalog includes locked skills; seeing a skill does not mean you own it.
guide.tensuranewworld.skills.details: 2. Open a skill and review its availability, costs, modes, and HOW TO UNLOCK. Requirements may depend on server configuration.
guide.tensuranewworld.skills.presets: 3. Use the set button to cycle through the Reincarnated presets, then choose SLOT 1, 2, or 3. Each of up to nine sets keeps its own three slots; changes are requested from the server.
guide.tensuranewworld.skills.passives: Passive effects can be toggled when supported. Cooldowns, energy, and prerequisites may prevent use; the skill card shows the configured slot keys.
guide.tensuranewworld.skills.great_sage: Great Sage also has its own panel on G. Its battle mode uses that panel's selection. Raphael and Ciel have different powers and costs.
guide.tensuranewworld.skills.racial: Racial skills for every species appear here. Morph appearance does not grant the race required by a skill.
guide.tensuranewworld.stomach.title: STOMACH / CURRENT STATE
guide.tensuranewworld.stomach.new_world: R > Stomach only shows New World item records. This tab cannot deposit, withdraw, or eat items, and does not mirror Reincarnated's native Stomach storage.
guide.tensuranewworld.stomach.equip: To use Predator, Gluttony, or Beelzebuth, open R > Skills, choose the skill and mode, select the desired preset, and equip a slot. Use the slot key shown on the skill card; hold it if the mode requires channeling.
guide.tensuranewworld.stomach.native_con: The native skill and its storage remain controlled by Reincarnated. Check Options > Controls > Tensura and the skill's own mode instructions for its native inputs; this panel does not operate that storage.
guide.tensuranewworld.stomach.absorption: Skills absorbed from defeated creatures appear in R > Skills, not as items in this list. Morph forms and the native Stomach are separate systems.
